name: Dr. Sachin Ladak Shedad
bio: Dr. Sachin Ladak Shedad is the Founder and Clinical Director of Suvacha Healthcare, a dedicated initiative focused on women’s health, safe motherhood, and integrative reproductive care. With strong academic training from IMS–BHU and advanced surgical expertise, he brings together modern obstetric science and Ayurvedic wisdom to deliver ethical, evidence-based, and patient-centred care.

items: Gynecology and minimally invasive laparoscopic surgery
Management of PCOD, hormonal disorders, and reproductive challenges

sections.title: Surgical & Clinical Approach
paras: Dr. Sachin Ladak Shedad follows a minimally invasive, safety-first approach, prioritising normal delivery whenever possible and recommending surgical intervention only when medically indicated. His practice is rooted in transparent counselling, informed decision-making, and long-term patient wellbeing.

sections.title: Role at Suvacha Healthcare
paras: As the clinical head, Dr. Sachin leads all medical services at Suvacha Healthcare and oversees the integration of Ayurveda with modern gynecology and obstetrics. He also manages clinical operations within Shree Seva Hospital, Talasari, ensuring high standards of safety, hygiene, and ethical practice.

items: Integration of Ayurveda and modern medical science
Focus on preventive care and safe motherhood

closing: Dr. Sachin Ladak Shedad’s mission is deeply aligned with the vision of Creating “श्रेयसी प्रजा” — nurturing healthy women, empowered families, and a balanced society through responsible and integrative healthcare.
roles2: Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist (Ay) | Gynec Laparoscopic Surgeon | Infertility Specialist
qualification: MS (PTSR) – IMS, Banaras Hindu University · FMAS – MUHS

sections.title: Role at Suvacha Healthcare

closing: Dr. Vaishali Mishra supports Suvacha Healthcare’s mission of strengthening fertility care through compassionate, integrative, and patient-first practices.
